title: A deferred last line, then a malformed and a flawed record appended
policy: P6: a last line without its newline is pending, not unread. P7 and P8 as in F36 and F39. Used by unsavedProgressIsNotCountedTwice for unread records counted but not yet saved.
derivation: Step 1: A [10, 1] = 11, and B's first half is pending (1 file). Step 2: B completes [20, 2]; a malformed line; C [30, 3] with cache read "lots" left out (flawed). [60, 6, 0, 0, 0, 3] = 66, 1 malformed, 1 flawed, nothing pending.
